# Inputs

Paper figures use SS3 recDev1 (MVLN via `ss3diags2`), SS3 recDev2 MCMC, and
JABBA3 (SS3 catch/CPUE through `ss2jabba3`), with constant and
state-dependent process error, for historical and current status;
projections under constant catch also include `SS3 FLasher PE` (recDev2 MCMC
terminal SSB and per-draw `SSB_MSY`/`annF_MSY`, with circular-block historical
recruitment residuals in `FLasher::fwd`). SS3 recDev2 MVLN is supplementary.
`SS3 FLasher det` is an MLE check (residual = 1, one iter), not a paper scenario.

```{r paths, cache=FALSE}
ssRoot="../data/ss3"
ssDirs=c("SS3 recDev1" = file.path(ssRoot, "HW2e_HW2d_InitFprior_0t_recDev1"),
         "SS3 recDev2" = file.path(ssRoot, "HW2e_HW2d_InitFprior_0t_recDev2"))

jabba3Cache="../data/runs/jabba3-sma.rds"

ssFcst=lapply(ssDirs, function(d) {
  f=list.dirs(file.path(d, "forecasts", "sd"), recursive = FALSE)
  f=f[grepl("^[0-9]+$", basename(f)) &
      file.exists(file.path(f, "Report.sso")) & file.exists(file.path(f, "ss3.cor"))]
  f=setNames(f, basename(f))
  f[as.numeric(names(f)) <= 2300]
})
ssFcst=Filter(function(f) all(c(0, 250, 1200, 1883, 2300) %in% as.numeric(names(f))) &&
                          length(f) >= 26, ssFcst)

mcDir    ="../data/mcmc/mceval"
mcPattern="MCMC_([0-9]+)[^/]*/derived_posteriors\\.sso$"
mcFiles  =list.files(mcDir, pattern = "derived_posteriors\\.sso$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
mcFiles  =mcFiles[grepl(mcPattern, mcFiles)]

baseOk  =file.exists(file.path(ssDirs, "Report.sso")) & file.exists(file.path(ssDirs, "ss3.cor"))
names(baseOk)=names(ssDirs)
hasBase =any(baseOk)
hasSS   =length(ssFcst) > 0
hasMcmc =length(mcFiles) >= 26
```

ssGrid=lapply(ssFcst, function(f)
  kobeMomentGrid(lapply(f, r4ss::SS_output, verbose = FALSE, printstats = FALSE, covar = TRUE),
                 years = annYrs, transform = "exact", bOffset = 1))
invisible(gc())

## SS3 MCMC

One `ss -mceval` per catch level over the same recDev2 posterior. SSB is at
the end of the year (`ssbLag = 1`), as for the MVLN.

```{r ss3-mcmc, eval=hasMcmc, cache.extra=tools::md5sum(mcFiles)}
mcKb=getMcmcRuns(mcDir, pattern = mcPattern, ssbLag = 1)
mcKb=mcKb[mcKb$catch %in% tacs, ]
```

## JABBA / JABBA3

JABBA3 is fitted to SS3 catch and CPUE via `ss3diags2::ss2jabba3`. SMA SSB is
spawning output in numbers, so `ss3_spm()` switches off r/K priors; we keep the
SPM shape \(m\) and an informed shark \(r\) prior. Two process-error forms share
that fit: **JABBA3** is constant \(\sigma\) (`sdb.form = "const"`), and
**JABBA3 dyn** is state-dependent, \(\sigma_t = \sigma_{MSY}(B_t/B_{MSY})^{-k}\),
from `jb3_tier2()` with no maturity lag. The dynamic level is scaled so the
average process variance matches the constant fit; \(k\) follows the
life-history prior.

```{r jabba3-helpers, cache=FALSE}
# Convert jb3_project() iters to the common draws table
jb3ProjDraws=function(pj, scenario = "JABBA3") {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(pj$iters), function(i) {
    it=pj$iters[[i]]
    catch=pj$scenarios$value[i]
    yrs=it$years
    B=it[["B/Bmsy"]]; H=it[["F/Fmsy"]]
    if (nrow(B) == length(yrs) && ncol(B) != length(yrs)) { B=t(B); H=t(H) }
    nd=nrow(B)
    data.frame(scenario = scenario, iter = rep(seq_len(nd), times = length(yrs)),
               catch = catch, year = rep(yrs, each = nd),
               stock = as.vector(B), harvest = as.vector(H),
               stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}
jb3HistDraws=function(fit, scenario = "JABBA3") {
  q=jb3_flqs(fit, draws = TRUE)
  st=as.data.frame(q$stock); hv=as.data.frame(q$harvest)
  data.frame(scenario = scenario, iter = as.integer(st$iter),
             year = as.integer(as.character(st$year)),
             stock = st$data, harvest = hv$data, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
```

```{r jabba, cache=FALSE}
jbFits=list(); jbPrj=list(); jb3Fit=NULL; jb3Prj=NULL
jb3FitDyn=NULL; jb3PrjDyn=NULL; jb3Draws=NULL; jb3Hist=NULL
  # Rebuild if the cache is missing, the TAC grid is short, or the
  # state-dependent fit is absent (older caches stored only constant sdb).
  jb3NeedConst=TRUE; jb3NeedDyn=TRUE; sp=NULL
  if (file.exists(jabba3Cache)) {
    jb3Cache=readRDS(jabba3Cache)
    jb3Fit=jb3Cache$fit; jb3Prj=jb3Cache$proj; sp=jb3Cache$spm
    have=sort(unique(jb3Prj$scenarios$value))
    jb3NeedConst=is.null(jb3Fit) || !all(tacs %in% have)
    if (!is.null(jb3Cache$fit.dyn) && !is.null(jb3Cache$proj.dyn)) {
      jb3FitDyn=jb3Cache$fit.dyn; jb3PrjDyn=jb3Cache$proj.dyn
      haveD=sort(unique(jb3PrjDyn$scenarios$value))
      jb3NeedDyn=!all(tacs %in% haveD)
    }
  }
  if (jb3NeedConst || jb3NeedDyn) {
    if (jb3NeedConst) {
      inp=ss2jabba3(ssBase[["SS3 recDev1"]])
      sp=ss3_spm(ssBase[["SS3 recDev1"]])
      d=jb3_data(inp$catch.total, inp$indices, stock = "sma")
      pr=jb3_priors(d, r = jabba3Rprior,
                    m = c(as.numeric(sp$pars["m"]), 0.15, 1))
      jb3Fit=jabba3(d, pr, jb3_model(shape = "pella", sdb.form = "const"),
                    ndraws = nDraw, osa = FALSE, run = "JABBA3")
      jb3Prj=jb3_project(jb3Fit, catch = tacs, nyears = max(annYrs) - max(jb3Fit$years),
                         ndraws = nDraw, imp.years = 2)
    }
    if (jb3NeedDyn) {
      # amat omitted: no production lag, so this differs only in sdb.form
      jb3FitDyn=jb3_tier2(jb3Fit, ndraws = nDraw, osa = FALSE)
      jb3FitDyn$run="JABBA3 dyn"
      jb3PrjDyn=jb3_project(jb3FitDyn, catch = tacs,
                            nyears = max(annYrs) - max(jb3FitDyn$years),
                            ndraws = nDraw, imp.years = 2)
    }
    saveRDS(list(fit = jb3Fit, proj = jb3Prj, fit.dyn = jb3FitDyn, proj.dyn = jb3PrjDyn,
                 spm = sp), jabba3Cache)
  }
  jbFits=list(JABBA3 = jb3Fit, "JABBA3 dyn" = jb3FitDyn)
  jbPrj =list(JABBA3 = jb3Prj, "JABBA3 dyn" = jb3PrjDyn)
  jb3Draws=do.call(rbind, lapply(names(jbPrj), function(s) jb3ProjDraws(jbPrj[[s]], s)))
  jb3Hist=do.call(rbind, lapply(names(jbFits), function(s) jb3HistDraws(jbFits[[s]], s)))
  cat(sprintf("jb3 draws %d hist %d years %s\n",
              if (is.null(jb3Draws)) 0 else nrow(jb3Draws),
              if (is.null(jb3Hist)) 0 else nrow(jb3Hist),
              if (is.null(jb3Hist) || !nrow(jb3Hist)) "none" else
                paste(range(jb3Hist$year), collapse = "-")),
      file = "../data/runs/knit-flags.txt", append = FALSE)
```

## Probabilities and draws

SS3 forecast draws are sampled from the MVLN moments with `kobeDraws` (per-TAC
`ss -sdonly` folders). JABBA3 draws come from `jb3_project()`. Kobe
probabilities use `kobe::smry`, trajectory quantiles `kobe::trks`.

```{r assemble, cache.extra=unname(tools::md5sum(jabba3Cache))}
ssProjFile="../data/runs/ss-project.rds"
hasSsProj=file.exists(ssProjFile)
flPe=if (hasSsProj) {
  sp0=readRDS(ssProjFile)
  d=sp0$kb[sp0$kb$scenario == "SS3 FLasher PE" & sp0$kb$year %in% annYrs,
           c("iter", "catch", "year", "stock", "harvest")]
  data.frame(scenario = "SS3 FLasher PE", d)
} else NULL
jbProjDraws=jb3Draws[jb3Draws$year %in% annYrs, ]
draws=rbind(
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(get0("ssGrid", ifnotfound = list())), function(s) {
    d=kobeDraws(ssGrid[[s]], n = nDraw, seed = 2026)
    data.frame(scenario = s, iter = NA_integer_, catch = as.numeric(d$run),
               d[, c("year", "stock", "harvest")])
  })),
  if (exists("mcKb")) data.frame(scenario = "SS3 recDev2 MCMC",
    mcKb[mcKb$year %in% annYrs, c("iter", "catch", "year", "stock", "harvest")]),
  flPe,
  jbProjDraws)
draws$scenario=factor(draws$scenario, scenarios)

prob=ddply(draws, .(scenario, catch, year), with, smry(stock, harvest))
prob$scenario=factor(prob$scenario, scenarios)
avail=levels(droplevels(prob$scenario))

band=function(d, by) ddply(d, by, function(x) {
  t=trks(x$stock, x$harvest, prob = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975))
  data.frame(quant = c("B/BMSY", "F/FMSY"), lo = c(t$stock[1], t$harvest[1]),
             mid = c(t$stock[2], t$harvest[2]), hi = c(t$stock[3], t$harvest[3]))
})
```

Historical draws: SS3 from `ss3diags2` joint MVLN; JABBA3 from fit draws.
Biomass is at the end of the year.

```{r hist, cache.extra=unname(tools::md5sum(jabba3Cache))}
ssHistDraws=if (length(get0("ss3stkHist", ifnotfound = list())) > 0) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(ss3stkHist), function(s) {
    q=ss3_flqs(ss3stkHist[[s]], c("B/Btgt", "F/Ftgt"))
    st=as.data.frame(q[["B/Btgt"]]); hv=as.data.frame(q[["F/Ftgt"]])
    data.frame(scenario = s, iter = as.integer(st$iter),
               year = as.integer(as.character(st$year)),
               stock = st$data, harvest = hv$data, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
} else {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(get0("ssHist", ifnotfound = list())), function(s) {
    d=kobeDraws(ssHist[[s]], n = nDraw, seed = 2024)
    data.frame(scenario = s, iter = NA_integer_, d[, c("year", "stock", "harvest")])
  }))
}
jbHistDraws=jb3Hist[jb3Hist$year %in% histYrs, ]
histDraws=rbind(
  ssHistDraws,
  if (exists("mcKb")) data.frame(scenario = "SS3 recDev2 MCMC",
    mcKb[mcKb$catch == min(mcKb$catch) & mcKb$year %in% histYrs,
         c("iter", "year", "stock", "harvest")]),
  jbHistDraws)
histDraws$scenario=factor(histDraws$scenario, scenarios)
hist=band(histDraws, .(scenario, year))
```

# Reference points

SS3 values are the maximum likelihood estimates (SS3 recDev1 and recDev2) or
posterior medians (SS3 recDev2 MCMC); JABBA3 values are RTMB mode / MVN
summaries (or NUTS medians if used). For SS3, FMSY is the annual apical F, and
BMSY and B0 are SSB in SS3 units (B0 as total biomass in tonnes is also given
for the MLE runs; `-mceval` does not report it). SS3 has no intrinsic rate of
increase, so \(r\) is the Pella-Tomlinson equivalent, \(r = m F_{MSY}\), with
the shape \(m\) solved from \(B_{MSY}/B_0 = m^{-1/(m-1)}\); for JABBA3, \(r\)
and \(m\) are estimated (shape informed by `ss3_spm`). Population doubling
time is \(\ln 2 / r\).

```{r refpts, cache=FALSE}
rpSs=if (length(get0("ssBase", ifnotfound = list())) > 0)
  refptsSummary(ssBase) else NULL
rpMc=if (exists("mcKb")) data.frame(scenario = "SS3 recDev2 MCMC",
                                    refptsSummary(mcFiles[1])) else NULL
rpJb=if (length(get0("jbFits", ifnotfound = list())) > 0) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(jbFits), function(s) {
    f=jbFits[[s]]; p=f$pars; rp=f$refpts
    data.frame(scenario = s,
               msy = rp["MSY", "est"], fmsy = rp["Fmsy", "est"],
               bmsy = rp["Bmsy", "est"], b0 = rp["K", "est"], tb0 = rp["K", "est"],
               shape = rp["BmsyK", "est"], m = p["m", "est"], r = p["r", "est"],
               td = log(2) / p["r", "est"])
  }))
} else NULL
rp=rbind(rpSs, rpMc, rpJb)
rp$scenario=factor(rp$scenario, scenarios)
rp=rp[order(rp$scenario), ]
knitr::kable(transform(rp, msy = round(msy), fmsy = signif(fmsy, 3), bmsy = round(bmsy),
                       b0 = round(b0), tb0 = round(tb0, -2), shape = round(shape, 3),
                       m = round(m, 2), r = signif(r, 3), td = round(td, 1)),
             row.names = FALSE, format.args = list(big.mark = ","),
             col.names = c("Scenario", "MSY (t)", "FMSY", "BMSY", "B0", "B0 total (t)",
                           "BMSY/B0", "Shape m", "r", "Doubling time (yr)"),
             caption = "Reference points by scenario.")
```

# Current status

Proportion of 2024 draws in each Kobe quadrant (`kobeEmpirical`): green
(B ≥ BMSY, F < FMSY), orange (B ≥ BMSY, F ≥ FMSY), yellow (B < BMSY,
F < FMSY) and red (B < BMSY, F ≥ FMSY).

```{r status-bar, fig.height=4, fig.width=8, fig.cap="Kobe quadrant probabilities in 2024 by scenario."}
hd=histDraws[histDraws$year == max(histYrs) &
               as.character(histDraws$scenario) %in% histScen, ]
kq=kobeEmpirical(transform(hd, run = as.character(scenario)))
kq=do.call(rbind, lapply(c("red", "yellow", "orange", "green"), function(q)
  data.frame(scenario = factor(kq$run, histScen), quadrant = q, p = kq[[q]])))
kq$quadrant=factor(kq$quadrant, c("red", "yellow", "orange", "green"))
kq=kq[!is.na(kq$scenario), ]
ggplot(kq, aes(scenario, p, fill = quadrant)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.7, colour = "grey30", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(p >= 0.04, sprintf("%.0f%%", 100 * p), "")),
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 4.5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = quadCol, name = NULL) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Probability") + theme_kobe()
```

# Historical trajectories

Intervals are the 2.5% and 97.5% quantiles from `kobe::trks`.

```{r hist-fig, fig.height=6, fig.width=10, fig.cap="Historical B/BMSY and F/FMSY with 95% intervals. The right-hand panel of each row is the marginal distribution in the last assessment year."}
hFig=hist[as.character(hist$scenario) %in% histScen, ]
hEnd=histDraws[histDraws$year == max(histYrs) &
                 as.character(histDraws$scenario) %in% histScen, ]
hEnd=rbind(
  data.frame(scenario = hEnd$scenario, quant = "B/BMSY", value = hEnd$stock),
  data.frame(scenario = hEnd$scenario, quant = "F/FMSY", value = hEnd$harvest))
histRow=function(q, legend) {
  d=hFig[hFig$quant == q, ]
  m=hEnd[hEnd$quant == q & is.finite(hEnd$value), ]
  ylim=c(0, max(d$hi, quantile(m$value, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE) * 1.02)
  tr=ggplot(d, aes(year, mid, colour = scenario, fill = scenario)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), alpha = 0.12, colour = NA) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim, expand = FALSE) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = q) + histScales +
    guides(colour = "none",
           fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 0.85))) +
    theme_kobe() +
    theme(legend.position = if (legend) "bottom" else "none")
  mg=ggplot(m, aes(y = value, fill = scenario)) +
    geom_density(aes(x = after_stat(scaled)), colour = "grey40", alpha = 0.45) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim, xlim = c(0, 1.15), expand = FALSE) +
    labs(x = max(histYrs), y = NULL) + histScales +
    guides(fill = "none", colour = "none") +
    theme_kobe() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_blank(), axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")
  patchwork::wrap_plots(tr, mg, widths = c(5, 1))
}
patchwork::wrap_plots(histRow("B/BMSY", FALSE), histRow("F/FMSY", TRUE), ncol = 1)
```


# Trends with terminal-year distribution

Median, 50% and 90% intervals of the historical draws, with a sample of
individual trajectories and the 2024 distribution in the margin, in the
layout of `kobe::trendPhaseMar2`. Trajectories are MCMC iterations, so they
are shown for the SS3 MCMC and JABBA scenarios only; the MVLN draws are
independent by year and are not trajectories.

Catch/MSY uses each scenario's own catch series and MSY uncertainty: SS3
MVLN from the delta-method estimate of `Dead_Catch_MSY` (log-normal), the SS3
MCMC from its posterior, and JABBA from the MSY posterior. Each trajectory
holds that iteration's MSY fixed over time.

```{r traj-fn, cache=FALSE}
wormIds=function(ids, n = nWorm) {
  ids=unique(ids[is.finite(ids)])
  if (!length(ids)) return(ids)
  if (length(ids) <= n) sort(ids) else sort(sample(ids, n))
}
```

```{r trend}
set.seed(2024)
ssCatch=lapply(get0("ssBase", ifnotfound = list()), function(x) {
  c1=aggregate(Obs ~ Yr, x$catch, sum)
  data.frame(year = c1$Yr, catch = c1$Obs)
})
msyDraw=lapply(get0("ssBase", ifnotfound = list()), function(x) {
  v=x$derived_quants["Dead_Catch_MSY", "Value"]
  cv=x$derived_quants["Dead_Catch_MSY", "StdDev"] / v
  exp(rnorm(nDraw, log(v), sqrt(log(1 + cv^2))))
})
if (exists("mcKb")) {
  ssCatch[["SS3 recDev2 MCMC"]]=ssCatch[["SS3 recDev2"]]
  msyDraw[["SS3 recDev2 MCMC"]]=as.numeric(FLRebuild:::mcmcTable(mcFiles[1])$Dead_Catch_MSY)
}
for (s in names(get0("jbFits", ifnotfound = list()))) {
  fit=jbFits[[s]]
  if (!is.null(fit$inputseries$catch)) {
    c1=fit$inputseries$catch
    ssCatch[[s]]=data.frame(year = c1[, 1], catch = c1[, 2])
    msyDraw[[s]]=as.numeric(fit$refpts_posterior$MSY)
  } else {
    ssCatch[[s]]=data.frame(year = as.numeric(fit$years), catch = as.numeric(fit$data$catch))
    msyDraw[[s]]=as.numeric(fit$draws$pars$MSY)
  }
}
histC=ddply(histDraws, .(scenario, year), function(x) {
  s=as.character(x$scenario[1])
  cbind(x, catch = ssCatch[[s]]$catch[match(x$year[1], ssCatch[[s]]$year)] /
                   sample(msyDraw[[s]], nrow(x), replace = TRUE))
})

tq=ddply(histC, .(scenario, year), function(x) {
  p=c(0.05, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95)
  qtile=function(v) {
    v=v[is.finite(v)]
    if (!length(v)) return(rep(NA_real_, length(p)))
    as.numeric(stats::quantile(v, p, names = FALSE))
  }
  q=rbind(qtile(x$stock), qtile(x$harvest), qtile(x$catch))
  data.frame(quant = c("stock", "harvest", "catch"),
             q05 = q[, 1], q25 = q[, 2], q50 = q[, 3], q75 = q[, 4], q95 = q[, 5],
             stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
})
term=histC[histC$year == max(histYrs), ]

# One sample of iterations per posterior scenario, reused for B, F and catch.
postScen=setdiff(scenarios, names(get0("ssBase", ifnotfound = list())))
keep=setNames(lapply(postScen, function(s) {
  d=histDraws[histDraws$scenario == s, ]
  wormIds(d$iter)
}), postScen)
postW=do.call(rbind, lapply(names(keep), function(s) {
  d=histDraws[histDraws$scenario == s & histDraws$iter %in% keep[[s]], ]
  if (!nrow(d)) return(NULL)
  rbind(data.frame(scenario = s, iter = d$iter, year = d$year, quant = "stock", value = d$stock),
        data.frame(scenario = s, iter = d$iter, year = d$year, quant = "harvest", value = d$harvest))
}))
msyAt=function(s, ids) {
  if (s == "SS3 recDev2 MCMC") {
    tab=FLRebuild:::mcmcTable(mcFiles[1])
    msy=setNames(as.numeric(tab$Dead_Catch_MSY), tab$Iter)
    return(msy[as.character(ids)])
  }
  fit=jbFits[[s]]
  if (!is.null(fit$refpts_posterior$MSY)) {
    msy=as.numeric(fit$refpts_posterior$MSY)
    all=sort(unique(jbHist[[s]]$iter))
  } else {
    msy=as.numeric(fit$draws$pars$MSY)
    all=seq_along(msy)
  }
  if (length(msy) != length(all)) return(rep(NA_real_, length(ids)))
  setNames(msy, all)[as.character(ids)]
}
catchW=do.call(rbind, lapply(intersect(names(keep), names(ssCatch)), function(s) {
  ct=ssCatch[[s]]
  ct=ct[ct$year %in% histYrs & is.finite(ct$catch), ]
  ids=keep[[s]]
  if (!length(ids) || !nrow(ct)) return(NULL)
  msy=msyAt(s, ids)
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_along(ids), function(i) {
    mi=unname(msy[i])
    if (!length(ct$year) || !length(mi) || !is.finite(mi)) return(NULL)
    data.frame(scenario = s, iter = ids[i], year = ct$year, quant = "catch",
               value = ct$catch / mi, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }))
}))
worms=rbind(postW, catchW)
if (is.null(worms) || !nrow(worms))
  worms=data.frame(scenario = factor(character(), scenarios), iter = integer(),
                   year = integer(), quant = character(), value = numeric())
worms=worms[is.finite(worms$value) & (worms$quant == "harvest" | worms$value > 0), ]
worms$scenario=factor(worms$scenario, scenarios)
trendMar=function(q, ...)
  plotTrendMar(tq[tq$quant == q, ], term, q, ..., col = scenCol,
               worms = worms[worms$quant == q, ]) &
  theme(text = element_text(size = 16))
```

```{r trend-b, fig.height=9.5, fig.width=9, fig.cap="B/BMSY: individual trajectories, median, 50% and 90% intervals, with the 2024 distribution in the margin."}
trendMar("stock", expression(B / B[MSY]), quadCol[["red"]], quadCol[["green"]])
```

```{r trend-f, fig.height=9.5, fig.width=9, fig.cap="F/FMSY: individual trajectories, median, 50% and 90% intervals, with the 2024 distribution in the margin."}
trendMar("harvest", expression(F / F[MSY]), quadCol[["green"]], quadCol[["red"]])
```

```{r trend-c, fig.height=9.5, fig.width=9, fig.cap="Catch/MSY: individual trajectories, median, 50% and 90% intervals from MSY uncertainty, with the 2024 distribution in the margin."}
trendMar("catch", "Catch / MSY", quadCol[["green"]], quadCol[["red"]])
```

# Kobe phase plots

The joint distribution is taken in the last year shared by every scenario that
has draws. Runs with no historical draws are left out, so an empty series
cannot set that year.

```{r phase}

phaseHave$scenario=droplevels(phaseHave$scenario)
phaseYear=max(Reduce(intersect, split(phaseHave$year, phaseHave$scenario)))
phaseRaw=phaseHave[phaseHave$year == phaseYear, ]
nPhase=min(500L, as.integer(min(table(phaseRaw$scenario))))
cur=ddply(phaseRaw, .(scenario), function(x)
  x[sample.int(nrow(x), nPhase), ])
path=reshape(hist[, c("scenario", "year", "quant", "mid")], idvar = c("scenario", "year"),
             timevar = "quant", direction = "wide")
names(path)=c("scenario", "year", "stock", "harvest")

invisible(kobe:::kobePhaseMar2(pts, xlim = 3, col = unname(scenCol[levels(droplevels(pts$run))]),
                               quadcol = kobeQuad,

knitr::kable(st[, c("scenario", "stock", "harvest", "green", "yellow", "red")],

# Production functions

Equilibrium surplus production and the historical catch trajectory, both
relative to MSY and BMSY so the scenarios share a scale. For SS3, the curve is
yield against SSB from `curveSS`. For JABBA, it is the fitted Pella-Tomlinson
surplus production against total biomass.

```{r pf, cache=FALSE}
# surplusError knows SS3 and classic JABBA. JABBA3 uses the same Pella-Tomlinson
# production, SP = r/(m-1) * B * (1 - (B/K)^(m-1)), with B and catch in tonnes.
jb3Surplus=function(fit, scenario) {
  r=fit$pars["r", "est"]; m=fit$pars["m", "est"]; K=fit$refpts["K", "est"]
  bmsy=fit$refpts["Bmsy", "est"]; msy=fit$refpts["MSY", "est"]
  b=fit$ts$est[fit$ts$quantity == "B"]
  d=data.frame(year = fit$years, biomass = b, stock = b,
               catch = as.numeric(fit$data$catch),
               pf = (r / (m - 1)) * b * (1 - (b / K)^(m - 1)),
               bmsy = bmsy, msy = msy)
  d$sp=c(d$biomass[-1], NA) - d$biomass + d$catch
  d$x=d$stock / d$bmsy
  d$pe=(d$sp - d$pf) / d$msy
  data.frame(scenario = scenario, d)
}
jb3Curve=function(fit, scenario) {
  r=fit$pars["r", "est"]; m=fit$pars["m", "est"]; K=fit$refpts["K", "est"]
  P=seq(0.02, 1, length.out = 200); b=P * K
  data.frame(scenario = scenario, b = b,
             c = (r / (m - 1)) * b * (1 - P^(m - 1)),
             bmsy = fit$refpts["Bmsy", "est"], msy = fit$refpts["MSY", "est"])
}
spe=surplusError(get0("ssBase", ifnotfound = list()))
spe=rbind(spe, do.call(rbind, lapply(names(get0("jbFits", ifnotfound = list())), function(s)
  jb3Surplus(jbFits[[s]], s))))
spe=spe[spe$year %in% histYrs, ]
spe$scenario=factor(spe$scenario, scenarios)

modelOf=function(s) factor(ifelse(grepl("^SS3", s), "SS3", "JABBA"), c("SS3", "JABBA"))
pfCurve=rbind(
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(get0("ssBase", ifnotfound = list())), function(s) with(curveSS(ssBase[[s]]), {
    cv=curve[order(curve$ssb), ]
    data.frame(scenario = s, b = cv$ssb, c = cv$yield, bmsy = refpts$bmsy, msy = refpts$msy)
  }))),
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(get0("jbFits", ifnotfound = list())), function(s)
    jb3Curve(jbFits[[s]], s))))
pfCurve=transform(pfCurve, x = b / bmsy, y = c / msy, scenario = factor(scenario, scenarios),
                  model = modelOf(scenario))

pfPath=transform(spe[, c("scenario", "year", "bmsy", "msy")], b = spe$stock, c = spe$catch,
                 x = spe$x, y = spe$catch / spe$msy, model = modelOf(spe$scenario))
med=reshape(hist[, c("scenario", "year", "quant", "mid")], idvar = c("scenario", "year"),
            timevar = "quant", direction = "wide")
names(med)=c("scenario", "year", "stock", "harvest")
pfPath=merge(pfPath, med, all.x = TRUE)
pfPath$quadrant=factor(with(pfPath, ifelse(stock >= 1, ifelse(harvest < 1, "green", "orange"),
                                           ifelse(harvest < 1, "yellow", "red"))),
                       c("red", "orange", "yellow", "green"))
pfPath=pfPath[order(pfPath$scenario, pfPath$year), ]
```

```{r pf-fig, cache=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=8, fig.cap="Production functions with Kobe regions: catch/MSY against B/BMSY. The dashed line is catch at FMSY (F > FMSY above it). Red: B < BMSY and catch > MSY; green: B > BMSY and catch < MSY; orange: B > BMSY and F > FMSY; yellow otherwise. The open circle is the first year and the filled circle 2024."}
xMax=max(pfCurve$x, pfPath$x, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.02
yMax=max(1.5, pfPath$y * 1.05, na.rm = TRUE)
lim=max(xMax, yMax)
ggplot(pfPath, aes(x, y)) +
  geom_polygon(aes(x, y, group = quadrant, fill = quadrant), data = kobePhasePolygons(), alpha = 0.6,
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(quadCol, yellow2 = quadCol[["yellow"]]), guide = "none") +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey30") +
  geom_line(aes(x, y), data = pfCurve, colour = "blue", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_path(colour = "grey15", linewidth = 0.4,
            arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.12, "cm"), type = "closed")) +
  geom_point(data = ddply(pfPath, .(scenario), function(d) d[which.min(d$year), ]),
             shape = 21, fill = "white", size = 2) +
  geom_point(data = ddply(pfPath, .(scenario), function(d) d[which.max(d$year), ]),
             shape = 21, fill = "grey15", size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~scenario, nrow = 2) +
  coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = c(0, lim), ylim = c(0, lim), expand = FALSE) +
  labs(x = expression(B / B[MSY]), y = expression(Catch / MSY)) + theme_kobe()
```

On absolute scales, catch is in tonnes. SS3 biomass is SSB in the units
reported by SS3 (not tonnes), and JABBA biomass is total biomass in tonnes, so
the two model families are shown on separate panels. Points are coloured by
scenario and filled by the Kobe quadrant of the median B/BMSY and F/FMSY that
year. The open diamond is BMSY, MSY.

```{r pf-abs, cache=FALSE}
pfAbs=list(
  geom_line(aes(b, c, colour = scenario), data = pfCurve, linewidth = 0.8),
  geom_path(aes(b, c, colour = scenario), linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.7),
  geom_point(aes(b, c, colour = scenario, fill = quadrant), shape = 21, size = 1.8, stroke = 0.7),
  geom_point(aes(bmsy, msy, colour = scenario), data = unique(pfCurve[, c("scenario", "model", "bmsy", "msy")]),
             shape = 23, fill = "white", size = 3, stroke = 1),
  colScales[[1]],
  scale_fill_manual(values = quadCol, name = "Kobe", drop = FALSE),

         fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(colour = "grey40"))),
  labs(y = "Catch (t)"), theme_kobe(), theme(legend.position = "right"))
```

```{r pf-abs-model, cache=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=11, fig.cap="Production functions on absolute scales, SS3 (SSB, SS3 units) and JABBA (total biomass, t) separately. Lines are the equilibrium curves; points are the historical catch, filled by Kobe quadrant."}
ggplot(pfPath) + pfAbs +
  facet_wrap(~model, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(c(0, 0.02))) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, NA), expand = expansion(c(0, 0.02))) +
  labs(x = "Biomass")
```

```{r pf-abs-all, cache=FALSE, fig.height=6, fig.width=9, fig.cap="Production functions for all scenarios on absolute scales in one panel. Biomass is on a log scale because SS3 SSB (SS3 units) and JABBA total biomass (t) differ by two orders of magnitude."}
ggplot(pfPath) + pfAbs +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +

# Process error

Process error is the realised surplus production minus that predicted by the
production function, in tonnes and scaled by MSY:
\(\{(B_{t+1} - B_t + C_t) - P(S_t)\} / MSY\). Positive values mean the stock
produced more than the curve predicts. For SS3, \(B\) is total biomass
(`Bio_all`), \(S\) is SSB and \(P\) is the equilibrium yield curve from
`curveSS`. For JABBA, \(B = S\) is total biomass and \(P\) is the fitted
Pella-Tomlinson curve. Catch above the curve in the production-function plot
means catch exceeded the predicted surplus production, not that process error
is positive. Computed with `FLRebuild::surplusError` (in the `pf` chunk);
regimes are from STARS (`FLRebuild::rod`).

```{r pe-fig, cache=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width=13, fig.cap="Process error (realised minus predicted surplus production, /MSY) by scenario: through time with rod() regimes, against B/BMSY (SSB/SSBMSY for SS3) with a loess smooth, autocorrelation with 95% bounds, and distribution."}
plotSurplusError(spe, scenCol) & theme(text = element_text(size = 16))
```

rdv=do.call(rbind, lapply(names(get0("ssBase", ifnotfound = list())), function(s) {

rdv=rdv[rdv$year <= max(histYrs), ]
rdv$scenario=factor(rdv$scenario, scenarios)
rdr=ddply(rdv, .(scenario), function(x) rod(x$data, year = x$year))

ggplot(rdv, aes(year, data)) +

# Projections

History from 2000 followed by the projection for each catch: a sample of
individual trajectories, then the median and 50%, 80% and 95% intervals from
`kobe::trks`. The dotted line is the last assessment year. SS3 recDev1 and
SS3 recDev2 history are the joint MVLN. Those draws are independent by year,
so the interval is drawn without a joined line. SS3 MCMC and JABBA3 lines are
the same draw in the historical years and the projection. FLasher lines are
the recDev2 MCMC draws that condition that projection, joined to the FLasher
iteration.

```{r proj}
# History for the two projection rows that are not in histDraws.
# recDev2: joint MVLN, same construction as recDev1. FLasher: the MCMC draws
# in data/mcmc/derived_posteriors.sso that condition the projection, numbered
# by the FLasher iteration so the line continues into the forecast.
extraHist=local({
  rows=list()
  if ("SS3 recDev2" %in% names(get0("ssBase", ifnotfound = list()))) {
    q=ss3_flqs(ss3stk(ssBase[["SS3 recDev2"]], output = "iters", iters = nDraw),
               c("B/Btgt", "F/Ftgt"))
    st=as.data.frame(q[["B/Btgt"]]); hv=as.data.frame(q[["F/Ftgt"]])
    rows[[1]]=data.frame(scenario = "SS3 recDev2", iter = as.integer(st$iter),
                         year = as.integer(as.character(st$year)),
                         stock = st$data, harvest = hv$data, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  }
  peFile="../data/runs/ss-project.rds"
  mcFile="../data/mcmc/derived_posteriors.sso"
  if (file.exists(peFile) && file.exists(mcFile)) {
    pe=readRDS(peFile)$kb
    pe=unique(pe[pe$scenario == "SS3 FLasher PE" & is.finite(pe$mcmcIter),
                 c("iter", "mcmcIter")])
    if (nrow(pe)) {
      h=readMcmcDq(mcFile, ssbLag = 1)
      h=h[h$year %in% histYrs & h$iter %in% pe$mcmcIter,
          c("iter", "year", "stock", "harvest")]
      h$iter=pe$iter[match(h$iter, pe$mcmcIter)]
      h=h[is.finite(h$iter), ]
      if (nrow(h))
        rows[[length(rows) + 1]]=data.frame(scenario = "SS3 FLasher PE", h,
                                            stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    }
  }
  if (!length(rows)) return(NULL)
  out=do.call(rbind, rows)
  out$scenario=as.character(out$scenario)
  out
})
keepH=c("scenario", "iter", "year", "stock", "harvest")
baseH=histDraws
baseH$scenario=as.character(baseH$scenario)
projHist=if (is.null(extraHist) || !nrow(extraHist)) baseH else
  rbind(baseH[, keepH], extraHist[, keepH])
projHist$scenario=factor(projHist$scenario, scenarios)
lv=c(0.5, 0.8, 0.95)
pr=c((1 - rev(lv)) / 2, 0.5, 1 - (1 - lv) / 2)
ciBand=function(d, by) ddply(d, by, function(x) {
  t=trks(x$stock, x$harvest, prob = pr)
  rbind(data.frame(quant = "B/BMSY", level = lv, mid = t$stock[4],
                   lo = t$stock[3:1], hi = t$stock[5:7]),
        data.frame(quant = "F/FMSY", level = lv, mid = t$harvest[4],
                   lo = t$harvest[3:1], hi = t$harvest[5:7]))
})
ciH=ciBand(projHist[projHist$year >= 2000, ], .(scenario, year))
ciH=merge(ciH, data.frame(catch = tacsFig), by = NULL)
ciP=ciBand(draws[draws$catch %in% tacsFig, ], .(scenario, catch, year))
ci=rbind(ciH, ciP[, names(ciH)])
ci$scenario=factor(ci$scenario, scenarios)

# JABBA3 historical and projection draws share iter numbers, so no thinning map.
jabbaHistIter=function(s) NULL
projPost=draws[is.finite(draws$iter) & draws$catch %in% tacsFig, ]
projPost$scenario=droplevels(projPost$scenario)
set.seed(2026)
none=data.frame(scenario = factor(character(), scenarios), iter = integer(),
                year = integer(), stock = numeric(), harvest = numeric(), catch = numeric())
picked=if (!nrow(projPost)) NULL else
  do.call(rbind, lapply(split(projPost, projPost$scenario), function(x) {
    ids=Reduce(intersect, lapply(split(x$iter, x$catch), unique))
    if (!length(ids)) ids=unique(x$iter)
    data.frame(scenario = x$scenario[1], iter = wormIds(ids))
  }))
histLeg=function(s, ids, catch) {
  h=projHist[as.character(projHist$scenario) == s & projHist$year >= 2000 &
              is.finite(projHist$iter), ]
  if (!nrow(h)) return(none)
  if (grepl("^JABBA", s)) {
    mp=jabbaHistIter(s)
    if (is.null(mp)) h=h[h$iter %in% ids, ] else {
      h=h[h$iter %in% mp[as.character(ids)], ]
      h$iter=as.integer(names(mp)[match(h$iter, mp)])
    }
  } else h=h[h$iter %in% ids, ]
  h=h[is.finite(h$iter), ]
  if (!nrow(h)) return(none)
  h$catch=catch
  h[, c("scenario", "iter", "year", "stock", "harvest", "catch")]
}
asTraj=function(d)
  rbind(data.frame(scenario = d$scenario, catch = d$catch, iter = d$iter, year = d$year,
                   quant = "B/BMSY", value = d$stock),
        data.frame(scenario = d$scenario, catch = d$catch, iter = d$iter, year = d$year,
                   quant = "F/FMSY", value = d$harvest))
if (!is.null(picked)) picked=droplevels(picked[is.finite(picked$iter), ])
postTraj=if (is.null(picked) || !nrow(picked)) NULL else
  do.call(rbind, lapply(split(picked, picked$scenario), function(pk) {
  s=as.character(pk$scenario[1])
  do.call(rbind, lapply(tacsFig, function(c0) {
    pr=projPost[as.character(projPost$scenario) == s & projPost$catch == c0 &
                  projPost$iter %in% pk$iter,
                c("scenario", "iter", "year", "stock", "harvest", "catch")]
    asTraj(rbind(histLeg(s, pk$iter, c0), pr))
  }))
}))
projWorms=postTraj
if (is.null(projWorms) || !nrow(projWorms))
  projWorms=data.frame(scenario = factor(character(), scenarios), catch = numeric(),
                       iter = integer(), year = integer(), quant = character(), value = numeric())
projWorms=projWorms[is.finite(projWorms$value), ]
projWorms$scenario=factor(projWorms$scenario, scenarios)

ciPlot=function(q, cap) {
  d=ci[ci$quant == q, ]
  d$hi=pmin(d$hi, cap)
  d$mid=pmin(d$mid, cap)
  w=projWorms[projWorms$quant == q, ]
  ggplot(d, aes(year)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = scenario, alpha = factor(level))) +
    geom_line(aes(year, value, group = iter), data = w, inherit.aes = FALSE,
              colour = "grey15", alpha = 0.45, linewidth = 0.25) +
    geom_line(aes(y = mid, colour = scenario), data = d[d$level == min(lv), ],
              linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = max(histYrs) + 0.5, linetype = "dotted", colour = "grey50") +
    facet_grid(scenario ~ catch, labeller = labeller(catch = function(x) paste(x, "t"))) +
    scale_alpha_manual(values = c("0.5" = 0.4, "0.8" = 0.25, "0.95" = 0.12),
                       name = "Interval") +
    colScales + guides(colour = "none", fill = "none") +
    expand_limits(y = 0) + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, cap)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = q) + theme_kobe() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5))
}
```

```{r proj-b, fig.height=10.5, fig.cap="B/BMSY by scenario and catch: individual trajectories, median and 50/80/95% intervals."}
ciPlot("B/BMSY", 3) + theme(text = element_text(size = 16))
```

```{r proj-f, fig.height=10.5, fig.cap="F/FMSY by scenario and catch: individual trajectories, median and 50/80/95% intervals."}
ciPlot("F/FMSY", 5) + coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 4)) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 16))
```

k2$catch=factor(k2$catch, levels = rev(sort(unique(k2$catch))))
ggplot(k2, aes(factor(year), catch, fill = green)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.2) +

  scale_fill_gradient2(low = quadCol["red"], mid = quadCol["yellow"],

                                title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5)) +

# Process-error projections (FLasher)

SS3 MVLN does not carry recruitment deviations into the forecast. The FLR
projection `FLRebuild::ssProject` does: the recDev2 MLE is read with
`ss3om`, the female unit is projected with `FLasher::fwd`, and historical
multiplicative residual series is circular-block resampled (not iid by year).
Results are cached in `data/runs/ss-project.rds` (run
`scripts/run-ss-project.R` to refresh).

```{r ss-project, cache=FALSE, fig.height=6, fig.width=10, fig.cap="FLR projection of SS3 recDev2 MCMC: deterministic recruitment (dashed) versus circular-block resampled historical recruitment residuals (median and 90% interval). Catch panels in tonnes."}
ssProjFile="../data/runs/ss-project.rds"
hasSsProj=file.exists(ssProjFile)
if (hasSsProj) {
  sp=readRDS(ssProjFile)
  tq=sp$sm[sp$sm$catch %in% c(0, 1200, 1883, 2300), ]
  tq$scenario=factor(tq$scenario, c("SS3 FLasher det", "SS3 FLasher PE"))
  pB=ggplot(tq[tq$scenario == "SS3 FLasher PE", ], aes(year)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q05B, ymax = q95B), fill = scenCol[["SS3 recDev2 MCMC"]], alpha = 0.35) +
    geom_line(aes(y = medB), colour = scenCol[["SS3 recDev2 MCMC"]], linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_line(aes(y = medB), data = tq[tq$scenario == "SS3 FLasher det", ],
              colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, colour = "grey50", linetype = "dotted") +
    facet_wrap(~catch, nrow = 1, labeller = labeller(catch = function(c) paste(c, "t"))) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 3)) + labs(x = NULL, y = expression(B / B[MSY])) +
    theme_kobe() + theme(legend.position = "none")
  pF=ggplot(tq[tq$scenario == "SS3 FLasher PE", ], aes(year)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q05F, ymax = q95F), fill = scenCol[["SS3 recDev2 MCMC"]], alpha = 0.35) +
    geom_line(aes(y = medF), colour = scenCol[["SS3 recDev2 MCMC"]], linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_line(aes(y = medF), data = tq[tq$scenario == "SS3 FLasher det", ],
              colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.6, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, colour = "grey50", linetype = "dotted") +
    facet_wrap(~catch, nrow = 1, labeller = labeller(catch = function(c) paste(c, "t"))) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 3)) + labs(x = NULL, y = expression(F / F[MSY])) +
    theme_kobe() + theme(legend.position = "none")
  patchwork::wrap_plots(pB, pF, ncol = 1)
}
```

# Recovery

```{r risk-fig, fig.height=6, fig.cap="P(green) against catch in 2030, 2045 and 2070. Dashed lines are the 60% and 70% targets."}
riskProb=prob[prob$year %in% evalYrs, c("scenario", "catch", "year", "green")]
riskProb$scenario=factor(as.character(riskProb$scenario), names(scenCol))
ggplot(riskProb, aes(catch, green, colour = scenario)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) + geom_point(size = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = targets, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  facet_wrap(~year, nrow = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = scenCol, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Catch (t)", y = "P(green)") + theme_kobe()
```

```{r rebuild-fig, fig.height=7, fig.width=10, fig.cap="First year in which P(green) reaches and stays above the target."}
rebuildOne=function(d, scenario)
  do.call(rbind, lapply(targets, function(t)
    do.call(rbind, lapply(split(d, d$catch), function(x)
      data.frame(scenario = scenario, catch = x$catch[1],
                 suppressWarnings(kobeRebuildTime(
                   data.frame(year = x$year, green = x$green), target = t)))))))
rb=do.call(rbind, lapply(avail, function(s)
  rebuildOne(prob[prob$scenario == s, c("catch", "year", "green")], s)))
rb$scenario=factor(rb$scenario, names(scenCol))
ggplot(rb, aes(catch, rebuildYear, colour = scenario, linetype = factor(target))) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(2023, 2073), breaks = seq(2030, 2070, by = 10),
                     expand = expansion(0)) +
  labs(x = "Catch (t)", y = "Recovery year", linetype = "Target") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = scenCol, name = NULL) + theme_kobe()
```

```{r tac-table}
tacTab=expand.grid(scenario = avail, year=evalYrs, target = targets,
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
tacTab$TAC=mapply(function(s, y, t) kobeTargetCatchEmpirical(prob[prob$scenario == s, ], y, t),
                  tacTab$scenario, tacTab$year, tacTab$target)
tacW=reshape(transform(tacTab, key = paste0(year, " @ ", 100 * target, "%"))[,
               c("scenario", "key", "TAC")],
             idvar = "scenario", timevar = "key", direction = "wide")
names(tacW)=c("Scenario", sub("^TAC\\.", "", names(tacW)[-1]))
knitr::kable(tacW, digits = 0, row.names = FALSE,
             caption = "Catch (t) at which P(green) equals the target in the given year.")
```

# Distribution shape

```{r dens-fig, fig.height=4.5, fig.cap="Distribution of B/BMSY and F/FMSY in 2070 by catch (t), within the 5th to 95th percentiles of the draws in each panel. F/FMSY is not shown for zero catch."}
dd=draws[draws$year == max(annYrs) & draws$catch %in% tacsFig, ]
dl=rbind(data.frame(dd[, c("scenario", "catch")], quant = "B/BMSY", x = dd$stock),
         data.frame(dd[, c("scenario", "catch")], quant = "F/FMSY", x = dd$harvest))
dl=dl[is.finite(dl$x) & dl$x > 0 & !(dl$quant == "F/FMSY" & dl$catch == 0), ]
dl=ddply(dl, .(quant, catch), function(x) {
  q=quantile(x$x, c(0.05, 0.95))
  x[x$x >= q[1] & x$x <= q[2], ]
})
ggplot(dl, aes(x, colour = scenario)) +
  geom_density(linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  facet_wrap(quant ~ catch, scales = "free", nrow = 2, drop = FALSE,
             labeller = labeller(catch = function(x) paste(x, "t"), .multi_line = FALSE)) +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_colour_manual(values = scenCol, name = NULL) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Density") + theme_kobe()
```
